# School Management Portal

> A secure, multi-school management system created by Elegant Empire AI for schools, vocational institutions, skills-training centres and specialised colleges in The Gambia.

Canonical website: https://school.elegantempireai.com/
Public product information: https://school.elegantempireai.com/product
Provider: Elegant Empire AI
Provider website: https://elegantempireai.com/
Primary market: The Gambia

## What the platform manages

- Student registration and unique student numbers
- Classes, subjects, attendance and timetables
- Fees, charges, payments, balances and printable receipts
- Results, grading, teacher remarks and report cards
- Staff invitations and role-based access
- Parent and guardian WhatsApp communication
- Excel exports, printable PDF reports and secure school backups
- Courses, programmes and qualifications for skills-training centres

## Organisation types

- Public, private, mission and community schools
- Vocational schools and skills-training centres
- Colleges and specialised institutes

## Security and privacy

Each organisation has an isolated workspace. Authentication and live school records are stored securely in Neon. Private school data and API routes are not public or intended for search indexing.

## Access

Accounts are created through controlled school onboarding. There is no unrestricted public registration. Contact Elegant Empire AI for onboarding and product enquiries.
